Regular Customer
May 2026 • Solo
Every time I visit HCMC, I make it a point to dine the buffet here. My last visit was in December, and I can confidently say the standard has improved significantly since then. The variety of food is impressive, and I especially noticed that the black pepper crab and lobster have improved tremendously — the taste and quality are now comparable to what you would get in Singapore.

As for the Singapore-style chilli sauce, it is not quite there yet, but still very delicious in its own way. Besides the seafood, many of the Japanese and Western dishes were equally enjoyable.

Overall, it is definitely on the pricey side, but the quality, variety, and dining experience make it well worth the money. Too lazy to take photos since the dishes have not changed much and i just want to enjoy the delicious food.

Bad experience
Nov 2025 • Family
Our experience at the Brasserie in Saigon was a real disaster from start to finish. We highly recommend this place.
🍽️ Poor Quality Food and Total Disorganization
We ordered lobster, but the quality was very poor. The main problem was the service: the dishes arrived "hiccups" with an embarrassing disorganization. One of us finished eating his portion before the other received his, forcing us to eat separately and completely ruining dinner. The environment was chaotic and confusing.
😠 Rude Staff and Poor Treatment
In addition to the food, we were treated awkwardly by the staff, who were rude and unprofessional in handling the flow of orders and our discomfort.
🤢 Serious Hygienic Consequences
The most serious thing happened next. Back home, we both suffered severe stomach pains during the night. This makes us seriously concerned about the freshness and hygienic preparation of the ingredients, especially the lobster.
In summary: A disastrous experience, embarrassing to the service and dangerous to health. Stay away from me.

Seafood buffet at La Brasserie is a good choice
Dec 2024 • Couples
Visit to La Brasserie at Nikko Hotel – December 8th
We dined at La Brasserie on the evening of December 8th, having wisely made a reservation in advance, as securing a table without one can be quite challenging. Arriving early, we were seated promptly as the restaurant opened.

I had heard glowing reviews of this seafood buffet from friends, as well as from online platforms and YouTube. My experience did not disappoint. The buffet featured an extensive array of seafood, including lobster, clams, oysters, and more. The dessert station offered a mix of Vietnamese specialties, fresh fruits, and classic Western desserts, all complemented by free-flowing wine and beer.

The staff were attentive and service-oriented, adding to the dining experience. Although the table-ordered lobster could have been served more quickly, considering the large number of diners, it was acceptable. Overall, this is a 5-star buffet experience, though there is still room for improvement in certain areas.

Pros:

Extensive seafood stations featuring lobster, shrimp, oysters, and more.
Traditional Vietnamese dishes like bánh xèo.
Attentive and courteous staff.
Suitable for romantic dinners, special occasions, or even casual gatherings.

Cons:

Reservations are essential due to high demand.
Prices are subject to additional taxes and service charges.
The dessert selection is decent but could be enhanced for a buffet of this caliber.

Regrets. One bite at a time.
Mar 2024 • Friends
Walked in and we should have known how bad things would be. The tables looked of poor quality and questionably pre poured water was on the table with missing table settings. But that, that was just the beginning. We proceeded to excitedly explore the buffet before our fell flat on our expectations as we found disappointment after disappointment. We ordered lobsters and oysters with cheese that did not come for over 30 minutes. They arrived and were dryer than jerky. We looked for other options but they were sadly lacking. Pan fried noodles were over cooked and dry. Pasta station was unstaffed whenever we went by. Customers were self serving at stations and were doing so without gloves and using their bare hands. Kids were self serving ice cream and making messes. In short, this was like a cheap poorly staffed and managed buffet. Don’t come here. My only wish at this time is to uneat this food. 

There were a few items that were okay. The Japanese beef station was good quality and seared well. Also the raw oyster station was done well. Regardless we wished we didn’t come here.
